subject: Request: Net-90 for enterprise renewal — Acme Health
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal terms — payment timing request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the renewal materials — we're aligned on scope and price, but our finance team requires Net-90 payment terms for all renewals processed in Q3 due to our fiscal calendar. Can Redwood accept Net-90 for the first year of the renewal for Acme Health? We will provide a PO and expedite counter-signing once terms are agreed.

Attached is our purchase order stub for now (Acme_PO_Q3_2026.pdf). If Net-90 isn't possible, please let me know other options (quarterly billing, milestone invoicing). Happy to schedule a quick call if needed.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Director, Procurement
Acme Health

Date: 2026-06-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal terms — payment timing request

Sarah — thanks for the note and the PO. I can confirm scope/pricing on our side. Looping in Marissa (Deal Desk) and Karthik (Sales Director) to evaluate a Net-90 approval and any conditions from finance.

Quick answers:
- We can accept a PO and start onboarding work once the contract is countersigned.
- Our standard is Net-30; Net-90 is an exception that requires deal desk + finance signoff.

I attached the latest redline (contract_redline_v3.docx) and a one-page renewal summary for context. I will follow up once Marissa/Karthik weigh in.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-17T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Deal desk review — Acme Health Net-90 request (RDW-DEAL-4273)

Karthik — quick summary for decision:
- ACCT: Acme Health (enterprise, renewal ~ $1.2M ARR)
- Request: Net-90 for invoice terms on renewal (one-year contract); PO provided
- Reason: customer fiscal quarter alignment; procurement requires Net-90 for Q3 renewals
- Impact: finance calc attached (deal_impact_calc.xlsx) — extending to Net-90 increases DSO and has ~$45k NPV cost this FY at our WACC assumptions; minimal collection risk historically (customer has been on-time).

Proposed guardrails if you approve:
1) Require signed PO and DocuSign (link to be sent by Vanessa).
2) No additional discount beyond current renewal pricing; if customer requests additional concession, submit separately.
3) Add clause: automatic card-on-file/ACH if invoice 60 days overdue.

Attachments: deal_impact_calc.xlsx (shows NPV impact), contract_redline_v3.docx (current redlines).

Can you approve Net-90 under these guardrails? If yes, I'll update finance and issue the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Deal Desk Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deal desk review — Acme Health Net-90 request (RDW-DEAL-4273)

Marissa — approved with the guardrails you've outlined. A couple of small tweaks:
- Add a clause that Net-90 is approved for the first renewal term only; future renewals revert to standard Net-30 unless finance approves extension.
- Require finance to perform a light credit reference check before we accept the PO (I want confirmation on payment history).

If finance signs off on the credit check and we keep pricing as-is (no further discounting), approve Net-90 for this renewal. Marissa, please confirm once finance sign-off is in and then issue DocuSign.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Director | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-18T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal terms — payment timing request

Sarah — good news: Redwood can accept Net-90 for the first year of the renewal for Acme Health, pending a short credit check from our finance team and a signed PO/DocuSign. Conditions:
- Net-90 approved for the first renewal term only; future renewals revert to Net-30 unless separately approved.
- Pricing remains at the quoted renewal rate (no additional discount).
- If an invoice is >60 days overdue, Redwood reserves the right to require ACH/card-on-file for subsequent invoices.

I've sent the DocuSign envelope for the renewal and attached the latest redline to the envelope. Please upload the formal PO when you have it (Acme_PO_Q3_2026.pdf). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/roster/abcdef123456

Let me know if you'd like a 15-minute call to walk finance through the steps.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
